objective: Show Tooga the way back to his wife, Torta.

description: My wife, Torta, sent me out to fetch dinner and I must have taken a wrong turn somewhere.
Would you be so kind as to lead me back to Torta? She's waiting for me just south of Steamwheedle Port.
completion: So he couldn't find his way back on his own? Figures.
Well, I guess you deserve something for your troubles....
